content: To get rounded QR modules without a canvas dependency, do not use qrcode's built-in toString('svg') (single combined path). Instead call QRCode.create() for the raw module bitmatrix and hand-write an SVG string emitting one <rect> (or rounded-rect via rx/ry, or <circle> for full rounding) per dark module — this is the standard approach used by dedicated 'rounded module' QR libraries (qrcode-svg, qrGrid). Rasterize that same custom SVG via sharp for the PNG path so PNG/SVG never diverge in module geometry.
